answer: Every claim climbs the canyon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Reaching the island of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
